data.text:
The salt-scented sea breeze... The sound of waves caressing my ears... And the twins bathing in the sea ever so delightfully... 
Is this what they call paradise? Shouldn't life be charging for a view like this?
Wait, whaaaat?! The twins are waving at me?!
Wha-What should I do?!
...Okay, okay. I'll just naturally, calmly, wave back at them, as if nothing happened...
Aaaah?! They waved back even harder?!
Goodness gracious! For a wall like me to be blessed like this...!
I'm so glad I get to spend this summer with everyone... Let's enjoy it to the fullest!
My heart can't take any more happiness right now...! I'll step out for a sec...
Ahh, the breeze feels so nice! Mhmm, 'tis the smell of summer!
My glowing skin is beautiful? Hehe, buttering me up won't get you anything!
I get wanting to play in the sea, but better not today. You didn't bring a towel, did you?
Maybe we should bring a lunch box for our next walk. I'll make potato salad and sandwiches!

Kick kick kick! Kick those legs! BAU BAU! Ehehe! I love the ocean.
Oh? You like my donut floatie?
Or is it my swimsuit that caught your eye...?
Ehehe! Lui-nee-senpai chose these donut floaties for FUWAMOCO. She said the patterns reminded her of us!
So Moco-chan has the same one, but in a different color.
Huh? You wanna eat it? No, no! This donut is the only thing keeping me afloat!
Go take a bite out of Moco-chan's if you must!
If you start to overheat, Fuwawa will go 'puff-puff' to cool you down!
Floating on my donut floatie is so comfy... BAU BAU!
The tropical flowers are so pretty... Which color do you like best?
Oh no! My donut's floating away! Wow, nice save! You're the donut saver!
Here! Over here! Ehehe! Try and catch me!
Did Fuwawa give you butterflies today? I was just... hoping I did...

Hey! What shall we do next?
We still haven't doggy paddle raced in the water yet, and we've got sand castles to make... Oh, and we gotta go out and find some pretty shells, and...
Huh? Beach volleyball? Hey, nice! And Lui-nee-senpai and Fuwawa are here too so we can all play together!
Oh, hey... Where did our ball go? Oh noe! It's floating away in the water!
Okay, leave it to me! For I have...a donut floatie!
Come on! Push me in my donut floatie out to sea! Quickly now!
Here I come, ball! Just a little closer... Got you! BAU BAU!

It may be hot, but not too hot for the fluff!
Get ready, BAU BAU!
Uugh... stop staring so much!... But does my swimsuit look good on me?
Throw! Spike! Phew, that was a great beach volleyball mental workout!
Take that! And that! WATER FIGHT! Get soaked! BAU BAU!
Heehee, watch out my little beach napper... You're getting buried in sand!
Let's go shell hunting before we go! And then you can give me all the pretty ones!
Here we go! Let's make some unforgettable summer memories together!
When it's hot, you just gotta yell it out! BAU BAU!
Ka-splash! Mococo drifting onto the stage!
What's more beautiful than the summer sky? Two twins smiling...
What's more beautiful than the summer sky? Two twins smiling...
Chef! Please go and bring us some Hiyashi Chuka!
I'm a wall, I'm a wall, I'm a wall...
I'm so glad I get to spend this summer with everyone... Let's enjoy it to the fullest!
All right, everyone! Please set your lightsticks to blue!
You're gonna turn into a hot dog before long! Haha!
Remember to stay hydrated, everyone! BAU BAU!
Hey, guys! Who likes Hiyashi Chuka? It's so yummy, yeah?
Wow! It looks so pretty! Just like the ocean!
Okay, guys! Who's ready to create summer memories together?
Moco-chan! We could hold a tropical concert!
I'm glad you like it, but... I wish you wouldn't stare...BAU BAU♪
If you start to overheat, Fuwawa will go 'puff-puff' to cool you down!
Whoa! Moco-chan, you're sweating so much! Are you okay?
So cute... Ah, no! Moco-chan is... Yeah, sexy, yeah!
Don't let the heat get to you, guys! BAU BAU!
I love your swimsuit, Lui-senpai! That's such a cute headband!
Yeah yeah! With the stage out in the water!
Everybody! Isn't Fuwawa's swimsuit soooooo cute~?!
Lui-nee! We're in the middle of a concert here!
I'm fine! The summer heat will never beat Mococo!
Aah... So hot! Lui-nee, do something!
Fuwawa, you know what I’m gonna ask, right? How do I look in my swimsuit?
It may be hot, but not too hot for the fluff! Get ready, BAU BAU!
